reviews.text: Really friendly, caring local practice.

I will be going again because they did it in a friendly way... and I have to keep the cat healthy enough to attack my feet should I make the mistake of letting them hang over the bed!

Absolute 10/10 staff. I’ve just adopted a cat and was able to get an appointment for the same day with an issue I couldn’t fix myself. I showed up stressed and nervous, and was immediately put at ease by the lovely receptionist, and then even more so by the outstanding vet service I received. We had to take our cat to the emergency in a really difficult situation and Dr Lionel saved his life. He was kind, calm, and took the time to explain things in a way we could understand. He offered solutions when we felt completely overwhelmed. And our cat who is very anxious at the vet, was calm and even lay down comfortably during the follow-up appointment.

We’re grateful we met him. Thank you for his hard work, and for being such a kind and excellent doctor.
Really welcoming team, made our first visit very comfortable.
Great initial visit.  I signed-up for the pet-plan there and then.  Why go anywhere else I thought?  My dog enjoyed it too!

The Crouch End branch of Medivet is such a special little practice. Every member of the team is kind, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do. You can truly feel how much they care, not just about animals, but about the people who love them. Our cat Malley is treated with such compassion and skill, we know he’s always in the very best hands.
Great place, friendly and trustworthy vets who you can get to know so you feel that your pet is in safe hands!

First time using this vet. I was so happy with this place... absolutely lovely people and the way they were with my cat was brilliant.  Best thing I did was register with this place.  Highly recommend..
Great practice with caring and attentive staff and a lovely receptionist :)
Very helpful, friendly receptionist and kind vets who looked after our cat with great care.
Friendly knowledgeable staff, great location, the furballs always get treated amazingly.  Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a new vet!
Staff are friendly and professional, highly recommend!

Have since moved vets. Our experience with Medivet Crouch end was difficult to say the very least. Conflicting advice from different vets. Quick to medicate with little to no explanation or consideration for root causes.
I will say that reception staff are doing their best but it did feel like their were a number of internal issues continuously affecting the treatment of our animal. I would not return to this branch of Medivet ever.
The clinic is clean, and the staff is polite and prompt in assisting patients. The doctors are kind and professional and address all concerns.

I am in pieces, my dog passed away after the vet told me she is fine after her surgery. They don’t know what they are doing and will do anything to just rip you off and neglect your fur baby like they done to my Maya. They are just after money not after taking care of animals. I strongly suggest to not use Medivet branches or animal hospitals they are linked too.

DO NOT COME HERE!!!! Our poor angel dog passed away last week due to their malpractice and negligence. They are not professional and will advise you incorrectly. Save your animal’s life and sign up with a different vet.

Lovely, friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Competent and reassuring vet. My usual Medivet branch in Hornsey was too busy and I was offered a same day appointment here. We (my cat and I) may come here instead in future.

Very accommodating and friendly. Answered any queries I had, being a new pet owner. I felt like I could trust their advice and were very kind to my cat while excited to help!
Reception is very welcoming and the vet staff very professional
So kind patient and professional . Dealt with me a panicking owner so well . Very thankful

Super happy with my first visit to medivet in hornsey. Vet was straight to the point, very friendly, taken by my little kitten Lulu Vialli. Gave me some fantastic tips and genuinely wanted to help and make everything super cost effective.

I have been taking my dog to Medivrt Crouch End for nearly 3 years now. Every visit we had was friendly, professional and on time. They always make sure all my questions are answered whether in person or on the phone. From regular checkups to my dogs post surgery follow ups. When we first moved to the area we wanted to go to Medivet slightly closer to our house but they were full and not taking new patients. Now we would never move. More than happy to walk the extra 15minutes to go this one

My much-loved tabby cat, Andy, was nearing the end of his life, losing weight and getting progressively weaker.  He was suffering from hyperthyroidism, renal impairment and chronic diarrhoea.  I took Andy to see Lionel, the resident vet, several times and he was always very helpful and pragmatic.  I never felt that he was trying to force me to spend money on investigations or treatments that would have little effect.  He was also very good at listening to any suggestions I might make (I am a medical doctor) and although one cannot always extrapolate from humans to pets he never ruled my thoughts out of court.  He was genuinely caring of Andy who responded by becoming less anxious over his visits.  Over the following weeks it became obvious that Andy was dying.  He responded for a short time to steroids and Lionel would talk to me over the phone to discuss recurrent prescriptions.  The nursing staff were also very helpful and caring when I phoned in with questions.  Finally we reached the time when Andy was doing very little and had no appetite.  He obviously had no enjoyment left in life so I sadly made an appointment to put him to sleep forever.  Half an hour before his appointment I started to get cold feet and was pleased to be able to talk to Lionel straight away who suggested that I should bring him in anyway and we could discuss the situation.  Once there Lionel examined Andy and discussed the situation with me without any rush and allowed me to come to the conclusion that the time had come.  The process of putting Andy to sleep was handled beautifully and he faded away quite peacefully.  Throughout the procedure the behaviour of the staff was exemplary.  They couldn't have done more to make a very sad situation tolerable.  I am grateful to them all.
Always welcoming and friendly.  Vets are thorough and kind.
The vet nurse was very friendly and the vet was also very nice and helpful! They seem to be happy working there which makes a huge difference:)
Great vets, always very friendly and helpful.

My recent MediVet visit was my dog’s initial check up on changing vets, and joining Medivet’s local practice. We were welcomed warmly and seen promptly. Great and friendly vet and keen care and attention was paid my dog. Made us both feel special.
